run_MDRunner_calculate: run a molecular dynamics simulation on a single structure using MDRunner.calculate with a configured thermostat and calculator
create_MDRunner: create an MDRunner instance with an ASE calculator, thermostat, atoms object, timestep, and total simulation steps
save_MDRunner_simulation_state: save the MD simulation state including atoms positions, velocities, and thermostat state to a checkpoint directory
load_MDRunner_checkpoint: load MD simulation state from a checkpoint directory to resume from a previous step
write_MDRunner_results: write MD simulation results metadata as JSON including trajectory file path, log file, and elapsed time
